::: {#def-input-matrix}

#### Input matrix, feature matrix

The **input matrix** (also called the **feature matrix**) $\mpredvar$ of a [data set](#def-data-set) $\dataset$ stacks the $\nobs$ inputs $\vpredvar_\iobs$ as rows,
with one column for each of the $\inputdim$ [input variables](#def-feature):

$$
\mpredvar = \begin{bmatrix}
  \tp{\vpredvar_1} \\
  \vdots \\
  \tp{\vpredvar_{\nobs}}
\end{bmatrix} .
$$ {#eq-input-matrix}

:::
